title: Industry glossaries
subtitle: Create and maintain industry glossaries that tenants can inherit; tenant changes never alter platform glossaries.
noTerms: No terms yet. Use “New term” or “Import”.

field.aliasesHint: Separate aliases with commas or semicolons.

deleteGlossaryBody: “{{name}}” and all its terms will be deleted.
deleteGlossaryInUse: {{count}} tenants inherit it; they will lose the inherited terms. Delete anyway?
importHint: CSV, one per line: term,aliases,definition (separate aliases with ;). A first line starting with term / 术语 / name is treated as a header.

duplicate.overwrite: Overwrite existing terms with the imported ones

industries.title: Industry dictionary
industries.hint: Provisioning, company info, industry glossaries and the template market all reference this dictionary. An industry in use cannot be deleted; disable it instead.
industries.name: Name

tenant.title: Tenant glossary
tenant.subtitle: Maintain this tenant's terms on top of the industry glossaries; they apply to every assistant of the tenant.
tenant.inheritHint: Click an industry tag to inherit it; several can be chosen. Terms follow the platform unless the tenant changed or removed them.
tenant.orderHint: When a standard term is in several industry glossaries, the one earlier in this order wins.
tenant.termsHint: Applies to every assistant of this tenant.
tenant.hiddenCount: {{count}} inherited terms deleted at this level
tenant.inheritedNotice: This term is inherited from the platform. Saving makes it a tenant term; the platform glossary does not change.
tenant.hideBody: “{{name}}” will be hidden from this tenant's glossary; the platform glossary is not affected. Use “Restore all” to bring it back.
tenant.submittedForApproval: Submitted for approval; it takes effect once approved.
tenant.approvalHint: Rule changes need approval in this tenant: they take effect only after approval.

toast.savedAsTenant: Saved as a tenant term; the platform glossary is unchanged
toast.hidden: Deleted from the tenant glossary; the platform glossary is not affected
